environment_policy: The template contains conspicuous CHANGE_ME placeholders only. Setup copies it only when .env is absent, rotates blank/CHANGE_ME passwords with openssl rand -hex 32, preserves other values, sets .env mode 0600, does not print credentials, validates Compose before startup, and waits for service health.
